verse.verse_2: there is no denying its coming
verse.verse_7: you shall be divided into three parties,
verse.verse_8: Companions of the Right, what are the Companions of the Right?
verse.verse_9: Companions of the Left, what are the Companions of the Left?
verse.verse_11: those are they brought near (to their Lord)
verse.verse_14: but only a few from the later generations.
verse.verse_16: they shall recline, facing each other,
verse.verse_17: (and there) shall wait on them immortal youths
verse.verse_18: with goblets and ewers, and a cup from a spring
verse.verse_19: that will neither make the head throb, nor intoxicate,
verse.verse_20: with fruits of their own choice
verse.verse_21: and any flesh of fowl that they desire.
verse.verse_24: a recompense for all that they did.
verse.verse_25: There they shall hear no idle talk, no cause of sin,
verse.verse_35: Indeed We formed them (the houris and all believing women),
verse.verse_37: chaste, loving companions of the same age
verse.verse_38: for the Companions of the Right
verse.verse_40: and a multitude of the later people.
verse.verse_41: As for the Companions of the Left
verse.verse_42: (they shall live) amid burning winds and boiling water,
verse.verse_43: in the shadow of a smoking blaze,
verse.verse_46: and persisted in the great sin
verse.verse_47: and constantly said: 'What, when we are dead and become dust and bones, shall we then be restored to life?
verse.verse_48: What, and our fathers, the ancients'
verse.verse_49: Say: 'Those of ancient times and those of later times
verse.verse_50: shall be gathered together to the appointed time on a known Day'
verse.verse_51: Then you went astray, you that belied,
verse.verse_52: you shall eat (the fruit) of the Tree of Zakkum.
verse.verse_53: You shall fill your bellies with it,
verse.verse_54: and drink boiling water on top of that,
verse.verse_55: and you will drink as the lapping of thirsty camels.
verse.verse_56: Such shall be your hospitality on the Day of Recompense.
verse.verse_57: We created you, why will you not believe!
verse.verse_58: Have you thought about what (sperm) you ejaculate?
verse.verse_59: Did you create it, or are We the Creator?
verse.verse_60: It was We who decreed death among you. We will not be surpassed
verse.verse_61: that We will change you and cause you to grow again in a way you do not know.
verse.verse_62: You have surely known of the first creation. Why then, will you not remember!
verse.verse_63: Ponder upon the soil you till,
verse.verse_64: is it you that sow it, or are We the Sower?
verse.verse_65: If We will, We would make it broken stubble and you would remain wondering,
verse.verse_68: Have you thought about the water you drink?
verse.verse_69: Is it you that send it down from the clouds or We?
verse.verse_70: If We will, We would make it bitter, why then do you not give thanks?
verse.verse_71: Have you thought about the fire you kindle?
verse.verse_72: Is it you that originated its tree, or are We the Originator?
verse.verse_73: We have made it a reminder, and a blessing to the traveler.
verse.verse_74: Then, exalt the Name of your Lord, the Great.
verse.verse_75: I swear by the fallings of the stars
verse.verse_76: and that is a mighty oath, if you but knew
verse.verse_77: it is indeed a Glorious Koran,
verse.verse_79: which none shall touch except the purified;
verse.verse_80: a sending down from the Lord of all the Worlds.
verse.verse_81: What, do you hold this discourse in disdain,
verse.verse_82: do you make it your provision to belie it?
verse.verse_83: Why, then, when the soul leaps up to the throat of the dying
verse.verse_84: and you are watching at that time
verse.verse_85: We are nearer to him than you, but you do not see
verse.verse_86: why then, if you are not revived,
verse.verse_87: do you not restore his soul, if you are truthful?
verse.verse_88: If he is among the near
verse.verse_89: there shall be calmness and ease, a Garden of Delight.
verse.verse_90: If he is a Companion of the Right
verse.verse_91: (he will be greeted with): 'Peace be upon you, Companion of the Right'
verse.verse_92: But, if he is of those who belied, and went astray,
verse.verse_93: there shall be a hospitality of boiling water,
verse.verse_95: Indeed, this is the certain truth.
verse.verse_96: So exalt the Name of your Lord, the Great.
